summary: Holley Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a $25 million share repurchase program approved by its Board. The program has no time limit, no minimum purchase obligation, and may be modified or discontinued at any time. Repurchases may occur on the open market (Rule 10b-18), in private transactions, or via other lawful means. The company reaffirmed its commitment to year-end net leverage below 3.5x. No price per share, premium, or specific timeline is stated. The program signals board confidence but lacks specific terms; watch for pace of buybacks and any leverage or debt reduction updates as indicators of execution. Risk-arb angle: minimal as this is an open-market authorization with flexibility.
